tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Creates a new document from markdown or HTML content. Requires a collectionId to place the document in a collection, or parentDocumentId to nest it under an existing document.

collectionId.description: The collection to place the document in.

format.description: The format of the text content. Defaults to "markdown".

parentDocumentId.description: The parent document ID to nest this document under.

publish.description: Whether to publish the document. Defaults to true.

text.description: The content of the document. Interpreted as markdown unless format is set to "html".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetches a document, collection, user, attachment, or template by type and ID.

tools.name: list_collection_documents
tools.description: Returns the complete hierarchical tree of published documents in a collection, including nested sub-documents.

collectionId.description: The ID of the collection whose document tree to return.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Searches documents the user has access to. Performs full-text search across document content when a query is provided.

collectionId.description: A collection ID to filter documents by.

query.description: A search query to find documents by content or title.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Updates an existing document by its ID. Only the fields provided will be updated.

id.description: The unique identifier of the document to update.

editMode.description: How to apply the text update. "replace" (default) replaces the entire document content. "append" adds text to the end. "prepend" adds text to the beginning. "patch" finds the exact markdown specified in findText and replaces only that portion.

findText.description: Required when editMode is "patch". The exact markdown substring to find in the document.

title.description: The new title for the document.
